comment: One entry per build of the game's program file (EBOOT), in the shared list format: title_id, region, app_ver, size and sha256 of the decrypted EBOOT, status (tested: the port is built from it; unsupported: refused), self_size/self_sha256 of the disc's encrypted EBOOT.BIN; Toro adds title, entry and text_size (entry point and size of the code segment, for a decrypted file that is not a known copy). Hashes, sizes and ids only, read from the maintainer's own discs. Checked by tools/release/eboot_ids.py.
